    Extract Daily Service and Subgroup Counts from Bike Logs

    daily_service_counts.Rd

    Evaluates continuous usage from 5-minute snapshot logs, tracking cumulative ride hours (snapshots where DOCID == "0"). Whenever a bike crosses an integer multiple of service_interval_h, it is flagged as due for service on that day.

    daily_service_counts(
  data,
  service_interval_h,
  tz = "America/New_York",
  interval_min = 5,
  start_hours = NULL
)

    Arguments

    data

    Data frame with columns BIKEID, DOCID, and time.

    service_interval_h

    Positive numeric service limit in ride hours (required).

    tz

    Timezone used to determine daily calendar boundaries (default: "America/New_York").

    interval_min

    Snapshot spacing in minutes (default: 5).

    start_hours

    Optional data frame (BIKEID, start_hours) of initial usage offsets.

    Value

    Data frame with columns day, n (observed bikes), and d (bikes due).
